ei.title: The Human Mind as a Weapon
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: How did the human mind evolve? One possibility is that competition and conflicts with other human tribes caused our brains to evolve the way they did. A human tribe that could out-think its enemies, even slightly, possessed a vital advantage. The ability of your tribe to imagine and predict where and when a hostile enemy tribe might strike, and plan accordingly, gives your tribe a significant military advantage. The human mind became a weapon in the struggle for survival, a weapon far more decisive than any before it. And this mental advantage was applied, over and over, within each succeeding generation. The tribe that could out-think its opponents was more likely to succeed in battle and would then pass on the genes responsible for this mental advantage to its offspring. You and I are the descendants of the winners.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① causing → caused: that절의 본동사 자리이므로 과거형 caused

❌ ① causing → caused: 'competition and conflicts ... caused our brains to evolve'에서 that절의 주어에 이어지는 본동사 자리이므로 과거형 caused가 와야 함. causing(분사)은 본동사가 될 수 없어 that절에 동사가 사라지는 오류 ←정답
✅ ② brains: 'caused our brains to evolve'에서 목적어 명사 — 적절
✅ ③ enemies: 'out-think its enemies'에서 목적어 명사 — 적절
✅ ④ possessed: 'possessed a vital advantage'에서 과거형 본동사 — 적절
det.tip: that + 주어 + 본동사(과거형): ... caused. causing(X, 동사 없음)

det.korean: '정신이 무기가 되었다'는 비유로, 사고 능력 자체가 생존 경쟁의 가장 강력한 수단이 되었다는 의미

❌ ③ 무기 기술이 뇌를 바꿈: 인과 방향이 반대
❌ ④ 폭력적으로 변함: 비유의 핵심은 폭력성이 아니라 사고의 유용성

무기 제작 기술이 인간의 뇌를 바꾸었다는 뜻이다

questions.passage: How did the human mind evolve? One possibility is that competition and conflicts with other human tribes caused our brains to evolve the way <u>they</u> did. A human tribe that could out-think its enemies, even slightly, possessed a vital advantage. The ability of your tribe to imagine and predict where and when a hostile enemy tribe might strike, and plan accordingly, gives your tribe a significant military advantage. The human mind became a weapon in the struggle for survival, a weapon far more decisive than any before it. And this mental advantage was applied, over and over, within each succeeding generation. The tribe that could out-think its opponents was more likely to succeed in battle and would then pass on the genes responsible for this mental advantage to its offspring. You and I are the descendants of the winners.

❌ ③ 경쟁과 갈등: 경쟁·갈등은 진화의 원인이지 진화하는 주체(they)가 아님
❌ ④ 우리의 조상들: 본문에 '조상'이라는 대상이 없으며 they는 brains를 가리킴
